Jordan / Stephanie — quick technical summary from the infra side after an initial pull:
- Confirmed anomalous preemption activity in the us-west-2 pool between 02:28:14–02:33:05 UTC; a cloud-side autoscaler triggered additional instance reclamation while a rolling promotion was in progress.
- Several in-flight KV cache misses and a transient increase in tail latency coincided with the preemption window; retries for short-lived checkout sessions exhausted clients' timeout budgets which surfaced as 503s.
- Collected artifacts: eviction logs, instance preemption events, scheduler timeline, and a combined trace bundle (trace_bundle_usw2_20270517.tar.gz). I've uploaded the bundle to the shared drive (link in related_links).

Preliminary note on eligibility: this looks like an infrastructure-induced availability gap; it may meet the SLA "availability" criteria depending on the exact per-customer routing and whether retries were served by fallback pools. We should run the request IDs Olivia provided against our ingress logs and compute the exact affected token count before making a final determination.
